/****************************************************************************
 * Name: social_resample_24k_to_16k
 *
 * Description:
 *   Convert 16-bit mono samples from 24 kHz to 16 kHz, three in for two out.
 *
 *   Here because the two ends disagree and neither can be talked round.  The
 *   cloud produces the spoken minutes at 24 kHz; this board's audio block runs
 *   from the 26 MHz crystal, where 24000 belongs to the 48 kHz family and needs
 *   an APLL sequence aud_clk_config() rejects.  vs_audio_params_valid()
 *   therefore refuses it -- correctly, since the alternative is speech at the
 *   wrong pitch rather than an error -- and without a conversion the whole
 *   spoken-minutes path ends at "sample rate 24000 unsupported" *after* the
 *   download has already been paid for.
 *
 *   3:2 is exact, so there is no phase accumulator and no accumulated error:
 *   output sample 2k sits on input 3k, and output 2k+1 sits halfway between
 *   inputs 3k+1 and 3k+2, which is what the average of those two is.
 *
 *   That average is also the only low-pass here, so content above 8 kHz
 *   aliases.  Speech at this rate has very little of it, and a real filter
 *   would cost cycles on the one thread that is simultaneously reading the file
 *   and feeding the DAC -- the thread whose underruns are already counted.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   in         - input samples; only whole groups of three are consumed
 *   in_samples - how many are available
 *   out        - receives in_samples / 3 * 2 samples
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   The number of samples written to out.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static size_t social_resample_24k_to_16k(const int16_t *in, size_t in_samples,
                                         int16_t *out)
{
  size_t groups = in_samples / 3;
  size_t i;

  for (i = 0; i < groups; i++)
    {
      const int16_t *g = in + i * 3;

      out[i * 2]     = g[0];
      out[i * 2 + 1] = (int16_t)(((int32_t)g[1] + (int32_t)g[2]) / 2);
    }

  return groups * 2;
}

 *
 * The release used to happen much later, in the session worker, after
 * social_finalize_sequence() had returned.  That put the whole tail of a
 * session -- up to a minute of polling for the minutes, the text fetch, the
 * history write, the spoken-minutes download and its playback -- between the
 * last frame anyone wanted and VIDIOC_STREAMOFF.  Nothing was leaking, but
 * the sensor, the YUV block, the JPEG encoder and the DMA channel all kept
 * running at the negotiated rate the entire time, with no consumer: measured
 * 2026-09-07, a session that ended at 10:45:43 was still emitting a frame
 * every 507 ms at 10:47:24, a hundred seconds later, and every one of those
 * frames also cost a console line over the mailbox.  That is CPU taken from
 * the download and the playback that were the only things still working.
 *
 * So the devices go here, at the one moment that is provably safe: both
 * producers have exited, so nothing is going to call grab() or read() again,
 * and the uploader has drained the rings, so nothing still references a frame.
 * The later social_release_devices() calls are idempotent and become no-ops.
 */

static void social_stop_producers(void)
{
  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);
  g_social.stop_capture = true;
  g_social.paused       = false;
  pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_social.cond);
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);

  /* Shorten the poll the capture thread may be sitting in, and stop the
   * microphone so the audio thread's read loop terminates instead of waiting
   * for a chunk that will never fill.
   *
   * capture_stop() rather than abort(): stop leaves what is already staged
   * readable, which is the tail of the conversation.
   */

  vs_media_stream_wake(g_social.camera, true);
  vs_audio_capture_stop(g_social.mic);

  if (g_social.capture_joinable)
    {
      pthread_join(g_social.capture_thread, NULL);
      g_social.capture_joinable = false;
    }

  /* The camera's counter, while the stream is still open and now that the only
   * thread incrementing it has stopped.  See social_state_s.
   */

  vs_media_stream_stats(g_social.camera, NULL, &g_social.frames_malformed);

  if (g_social.audio_joinable)
    {
      pthread_join(g_social.audio_thread, NULL);
      g_social.audio_joinable = false;
    }

  /* Only now can the uploader be told no more work is coming.  Setting this
   * any earlier -- with stop_capture, which is the obvious place -- would let
   * it leave before the audio worker had pushed the tail chunk, and those last
   * two seconds would be freed unsent.  The uploader drains whatever is in the
   * ring before it acts on this.
   */

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);
  g_social.producers_done = true;
  pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_social.cond);
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);

  if (g_social.upload_joinable)
    {
      pthread_join(g_social.upload_thread, NULL);
      g_social.upload_joinable = false;
    }

  /* Nothing above this line will touch either device again, so the camera and
   * the microphone are released now rather than at the end of the session.
   * See the header comment for what the delay used to cost.
   *
   * This also frees the poll scratch, which is correct here: the session
   * thread's polling loop has already ended by the time either caller reaches
   * this function.
   */

  social_release_devices();
}

 * STREAMOFF and an ADC teardown off it.
 *
 * Idempotent: called on the normal path and again from the shared cleanup
 * tail, and the second call finds nothing to do.
 */

static void social_release_devices(void)
{
  struct vs_media_stream_s *camera;
  struct vs_audio_cap_s *mic;
  struct social_poll_scratch_s *poll;
  bool poll_psram;

  pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);
  camera = g_social.camera;
  mic    = g_social.mic;
  poll   = g_social.poll;
  poll_psram = g_social.poll_psram;

两处修复都在 `app/velasight/vs_social.c`，固件已按 `docs/固件构建步骤.md` 构建并通过全部校验。

## 修复一：相机/麦克风释放时机（你报的问题）

把 `social_release_devices()` 从 session worker 的尾部提到了 `social_stop_producers()` 的末尾 —— 也就是三个 producer 全部 join 完、上传环已排空的那一刻。这是可证明安全的最早时点：不会再有人调 `grab()` 或 `read()`，也不会再有帧被引用。后续原有的 `social_release_devices()` 调用因幂等变成 no-op，`goto release` 那条 spawn 失败路径仍然由它做实际释放。

配套解掉了一个顺序矛盾：`social_log_totals()` 原来要读 `vs_media_stream_stats(g_social.camera, ...)`，需要句柄还活着，而硬件需要句柄尽早消失。现在在 capture 线程 join 之后把 malformed 计数快照进 `social_state_s::frames_malformed`（此时计数已终态、流还开着），打印时读快照。delivered 没有快照，因为 `vs_media_stream_close()` 本来就会打印它，而 totals 行里的帧数用的是 `image_seq`。

效果：`VIDIOC_STREAMOFF` 从"轮询 + 落盘 + TTS 下载 + 播放全部结束之后"提前到"用户松手后几秒"。你日志里那 100.8 s 的 507 ms 周期 `set_buf` 会缩短到 finalize 开头的几秒内结束。

## 修复二：24 kHz TTS 播不出来

这是同一条路径上的下一个拦路石，我一并修了 —— 否则刷了固件也只会看到 `vs_audio: sample rate 24000 unsupported`。新增 `social_resample_24k_to_16k()` 做 3:2 转换：输出样本 2k 落在输入 3k，2k+1 落在输入 3k+1 与 3k+2 的中点（取二者平均，也就是该位置的线性插值）。3:2 是精确比，没有相位累加器；chunk 边界用一个 2 样本的 carry 接续，短读也不会丢样本或滑相位。DAC 改用 `play_rate` 打开，非 24 kHz 单声道的文件行为不变。

需要知道的取舍：那次平均是唯一的低通，8 kHz 以上会折叠。语音在这个采样率下高频很少，而真正的滤波器要花在同时读文件又喂 DAC 的那条线程上 —— 就是 underrun 计数已经在盯的那条。如果听感不行，更干净的解法是请云端直接按 16 kHz 生成，那样这段转换可以整块删掉。

## 还没验证的部分

我只做了构建校验，没有烧录也没有上板跑。要确认这两个修复真的生效，需要看一次真实会话的日志：

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: social_resample_24k_to_16k
 *
 * Description:
 *   Convert 16-bit mono samples from 24 kHz to 16 kHz, three in for two out.
 *
 *   Here because the two ends disagree and neither can be talked round.  The
 *   cloud produces the spoken minutes at 24 kHz; this board's audio block runs
 *   from the 26 MHz crystal, where 24000 belongs to the 48 kHz family and needs
 *   an APLL sequence aud_clk_config() rejects.  vs_audio_params_valid()
 *   therefore refuses it -- correctly, since the alternative is speech at the
 *   wrong pitch rather than an error -- and without a conversion the whole
 *   spoken-minutes path ends at "sample rate 24000 unsupported" *after* the
 *   download has already been paid for.
 *
 *   3:2 is exact, so there is no phase accumulator and no accumulated error:
 *   output sample 2k sits on input 3k, and output 2k+1 sits halfway between
 *   inputs 3k+1 and 3k+2, which is what the average of those two is.
 *
 *   That average is also the only low-pass here, so content above 8 kHz
 *   aliases.  Speech at this rate has very little of it, and a real filter
 *   would cost cycles on the one thread that is simultaneously reading the file
 *   and feeding the DAC -- the thread whose underruns are already counted.
 *
 * Input Parameters:
 *   in         - input samples; only whole groups of three are consumed
 *   in_samples - how many are available
 *   out        - receives in_samples / 3 * 2 samples
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   The number of samples written to out.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static size_t social_resample_24k_to_16k(const int16_t *in, size_t in_samples,
                                         int16_t *out)
{
  size_t groups = in_samples / 3;
  size_t i;

  for (i = 0; i < groups; i++)
    {
      const int16_t *g = in + i * 3;

      out[i * 2]     = g[0];
      out[i * 2 + 1] = (int16_t)(((int32_t)g[1] + (int32_t)g[2]) / 2);
    }

  return groups * 2;
}

text:
从长按返回到播完 TTS，一共跨三个线程。以下按代码实际顺序，全部为只读阅读，函数名为准（vs_social.c 行号因本次改动有位移，故不引用）。

## 阶段 0 — 按键：长按返回（UI 线程）

按住返回键超过 `CONFIG_VS_SHORT_PRESS_MAX_MS`（500 ms）后，`vs_input.c` 开始发 `VS_INPUT_PROGRESS`，进度按 `(held - 500) / (2000 - 500)` 归一。第一个 PROGRESS 在 vs_app.c:1868 把页面切到 `VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING`、记下 `social_exit_return_page`，并**同步**刷一帧（`vs_render_now()`）—— 注释说明只有这一次转换需要立即可见，"我的按住有没有登记"是唯一要抢的信息；后续 ticks 只是长环，交给主循环的 `vs_display_tick()`。

屏幕：左「结束交流 / 继续按住」，右进度环 +「结束 N% / 按住中」。中途松手 → `VS_INPUT_CANCEL` → 回 `social_exit_return_page`，会话继续采集。

满 `CONFIG_VS_LONG_PRESS_MS`（2000 ms）→ `VS_INPUT_LONG`。

## 阶段 1 — 发起结束（UI 线程，非阻塞）

vs_app.c:2492 调 `vs_social_finalize(runtime->active_request_id)` —— **复用会话原有的 request_id**，不新抽一个，因为轮询循环里还在飞的事件带的是旧 id，换 id 会让 UI 在 finalize 的这几十秒里把它们全丢掉。

`vs_social_finalize()` 持锁置 `finalize = true`、采纳传入的 request_id、broadcast、打印 `vs_social: finalizing`，立刻返回。

- 返回 0 → 页面切 `VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING`（左「整理记录 / 正在生成建议」，右「整理中 / 处理中」），再 `vs_render_now()`
- 返回 `-EINVAL`（会话已自行结束，或这是第二次长按）→ 不进 FINALIZING，直接回 `vs_browse_page()`

同一时刻 UI 主循环武装阶段看门狗：`FINALIZE_TIMEOUT_MS + 20000` = **80 s**。

## 阶段 2 — session 线程跳出轮询

session worker 的主循环每 `CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS`（1500 ms）检查一次 `finalize/abort`，所以从置位到跳出**最多 1.5 s**。跳出后进 `social_finalize_sequence()`。

## 阶段 3 — 停采集并交还硬件（`social_stop_producers()`）

顺序是有讲究的，每一步都有它必须在那个位置的理由：

1. 置 `stop_capture=true`、`paused=false`、broadcast
2. `vs_media_stream_wake(camera, true)` → 后续 `grab()` 全返 `-ECANCELED`
3. `vs_audio_capture_stop(mic)` —— stop 而非 abort，已 staged 的尾音仍可读
4. join capture 线程
5. **快照 `frames_malformed`** —— 此时计数已终态、流还开着
6. join audio 线程 —— 它退出前会把 ≥ 1/8 块（250 ms）的残块编码后推入环，即对话的最后一句
7. 置 `producers_done=true`、broadcast —— 必须晚于第 6 步，否则 uploader 会在尾块入环前离开，那两秒被 free 掉
8. join upload 线程 —— 它先把音频环和图像环排空
9. **`social_release_devices()`** —— 锁内摘句柄置 NULL、锁外 `vs_media_stream_close()`（STREAMOFF + munmap + REQBUFS(0) + close，打印 `vs_media: stream closed, N frames, M malformed`）和 `vs_audio_capture_close()`，并释放 poll scratch

第 9 步是本次修复挪上来的。在此之前它在 session worker 尾部，也就是整条 finalize 走完之后 —— 相机会在阶段 4~10 全程空转。

## 阶段 4 — DELETE 关会话

`vs_cloud_social_finalize()` → `DELETE /contest/v1/session`，body `{deviceId, sessionId, timestamp}`。接受 status **40**（关闭中，文档的成功码）或 0，取 `value.msgId`，打印 `vs_cloud: session ... closing, result under msg N`。

失败 → post `SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED` 并 return，**不播 TTS**。

## 阶段 5 — 分配响应缓冲

`CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_RESP_MAX_BYTES`（64 KB），PSRAM 优先。失败 → `SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED(-ENOMEM)`。

## 阶段 6 — 轮询最终结果

`deadline = now + CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_TIMEOUT_MS`（60 s），然后循环 `vs_cloud_social_get_result()`：

`GET /contest/v1/getResult?data=<urlencoded {"msgId":["N"],"deviceId":…,"sessionId":…,"timestamp":…}>`

条目筛选只认 `msgEvent==2 && status==21`（文档「约定会话关闭完毕用 21 表示」）。40/10/11 → `-EAGAIN`；30 → `-EIO` 并把 `log` 塞进 summary；其它形状 → `-EAGAIN`。

命中之后，在同一次调用里按顺序做三件事：

1. `cloud_resolve_text_minutes()` —— `txtMinutes` 若是 URL 就先下载成文本并**替换进 JSON**，这样落盘的是文字而不是一小时后失效的链接。这是整个轮询里唯一碰网络的地方，且只在即将成功的那一次。打印 `text minutes fetched, N bytes`
2. 序列化整个 `response` 对象进 body —— 先序列化再填 `minutes`，所以缓冲太小时报 `-E2BIG` 而 `minutes` 还没被动过
3. 填 `minutes`：`ttsMinutes` → `tts_url`、`txtMinutes` → `summary`、`emotionTimeline` 折成 calm/happy/tense 三个百分比、`audioTimeline` 只数条目数

`-EAGAIN` 时依次检查 `abort`（是则释放 body 直接 return，**不 post 任何事件**）→ 检查 deadline → `usleep(1500 ms)` 再来。超时 → `-ETIMEDOUT` → `SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED`。

成功后打印 `vs_social: minutes: calm .. happy .. tense .., N emotion / M audio samples, text .., tts ..`。

注意超时判定在 `get_result` **返回之后**才做，所以墙钟可以超过 60 s 一个往返加一次 txtMinutes 下载 —— 你那份日志里是 64.2 s。

## 阶段 7 — 落盘

`social_persist_minutes()` → `vs_history_append(VS_HISTORY_KIND_SOCIAL, &index, body)`，排在 post RESULT **之前**，所以屏上有摘要就等于卡上有记录。

index 字段：`date`（`localtime_r`，无 RTC 时年份不真实但仍写，至少能在一次开机内排序）、`title` 固定「面对面交流」、`summary`（空则「本次没有生成摘要」）、`calm/happy/tense`、`incomplete`（summary 为空**或** `emotion_samples==0` 时置位）。record body 是 `response` 的完整序列化，Web 历史页读它。

失败 → `SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED`，不播。注释的理由：告诉用户存好了其实没存，比告诉他没存更糟。

## 阶段 8 — post SOCIAL_RESULT，屏幕出摘要

`social_post()` 带会话的 request_id，UI 队列满时重试 3 次 × 2 ms（不丢，但也不久等，因为调用方可能就是唯一排空该队列的 UI 线程）。

UI 侧 vs_app.c:1725 只在页面**仍是 FINALIZING** 时生效：text 为空 → 报 `-EBADMSG`「社交摘要为空」；否则写 `result_text`、切 `VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESULT`、`vs_show_newest_record()` 把浏览页指向 index 0。屏幕变成左「交流摘要 / <摘要>」，右「结果 / 摘要已生成」。

**页面一离开 FINALIZING，下一轮主循环就把 80 s 阶段看门狗清零** —— 所以阶段 9、10 不受任何超时约束，多长都不会被掐。

## 阶段 9 — ack

`vs_cloud_social_ack()` 只打一行 `session ... complete (no cloud ack endpoint; local no-op)`。云端设备侧四个接口里没有 ack，这是刻意保留的空位。

## 阶段 10 — 取 TTS 并播放（`social_play_minutes_audio()`）

排在 post RESULT 之后是刻意的：先出字再出声，同时也是安全顺序 —— 记录已写、结果页已上屏，之后才去做一次几百 KB 的下载和一次 DAC open。

1. `tts_url` 为空 → 直接 return
2. `social_minutes_dir()` mkdir 父目录
3. `vs_cloud_download_to_file(url, /mnt/sdnand/ai_agent/minutes.wav, 8 MB, &file_len)`
   - 相对 URL 按已配置的云端 host 解析；`https://` 走 TLS（由 URL scheme 决定，与 API 走明文无关）；`mock://` 返回 `-EPROTONOSUPPORT`
   - 边收边写，内存只有一个 8 KB 传输缓冲，所以文件多大都不涨内存；每 128 KB 打一行 `download N bytes`
   - 超预算 `-EFBIG` / 写失败 / HTTP 非 2xx / 空 body → `unlink()` 删掉残文件，免得下次被当成好文件播
   - 打印 `spoken minutes saved to ..., N bytes`
4. `social_wav_open()` 解析 RIFF/WAVE，最多走 64 个 chunk（防止字段是垃圾时无限遍历），要求 `fmt=1`(PCM)，data 长度取「头里声明的」与「文件实际剩余的」较小值
5. `bits != 16` → 放弃
6. 打印 `spoken minutes N bytes, R Hz C ch 16-bit, X.X s`
7. `vs_audio_playback_open(AGENT_AUDIO_PLAYBACK_DEV, rate, channels, bits)` —— rate 原样传给 DAC，只有 8000/16000/32000 能过
8. 循环，每次最多 8 KB：先查 `g_social.abort`（是则 `vs_audio_playback_stop()` 跳出，粒度约 170 ms/片）→ `read()` → `vs_audio_playback_write()` → `done += n`
9. `vs_audio_playback_drain()` 等放完；underrun > 0 则打印次数；`vs_audio_playback_close()`
10. WAV 留在卡上不删（固定路径不会累积，留着便于复查音质投诉）

这一整步是 best-effort：任何失败都只打日志，不改事件、不改页面。摘要已经在屏上了。

## 阶段 11 — session 线程收尾

回到 session worker：`social_log_totals()` 打 `session ... totals: N frames (M malformed), ...`（用阶段 3 的快照）→ `social_release_devices()`（已是 no-op）→ `done:` → `social_queue_flush()` → 再一次 no-op 释放 → 锁内 `running = false`、broadcast。

**只有到这一刻 `vs_social_active()` 才变 false**，才能开始下一次会话。在此之前长按进社交会拿到 `-EBUSY`，UI 显示「上一次交流还在收尾，稍等」。

## 阶段 12 — 用户离开结果页

`VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESULT` 上确认键或返回键短按 → `vs_cancel_request()` → `vs_browse_page()`（通常是 `VS_PAGE_HISTORY`，已指向刚写的记录）。

| 段 | 界 |
| --- | --- |
| 长按判定 | 2000 ms |
| 置位 → session 线程响应 | ≤ 1500 ms |

record_key 格式是 `VS_HISTORY_KEY_FMT "R%07u"`，即 `R` + 7 位十进制，恰好 8 字符；配 `.JSN` 扩展名 → `R0000123.JSN` 严格 8.3 合规。所以派生音频名 `R0000123.WAV` 同样 8.3 安全。目录用 `mkdir(..., 0700)` 在 `vs_history_open()` 里逐级创建（vs_history.c:858-875）。其它常量：`VS_HISTORY_PATH_MAX 96`、`VS_HISTORY_SEQ_MAX 9999999`、`VS_HISTORY_INDEX_MAX = MAX_RECORDS*1024+2`（索引文本超过就 -E2BIG）、`VS_HISTORY_SEQ_PROBES = MAX_RECORDS+1024`。

**struct vs_history_index_s 全部字段（vs_history.h:30-41）**

```c
struct vs_history_index_s
{
  enum vs_history_kind_e kind;              /* SOCIAL / CHAT */
  char     record_key[VS_HISTORY_KEY_MAX];  /* 16，实际 "R0000000" */
  char     date[VS_TEXT_SHORT];             /* 40 */
  char     title[VS_TEXT_SHORT];            /* 40 */
  char     summary[VS_TEXT_LONG];           /* 128 */
  uint8_t  calm; uint8_t happy; uint8_t tense;   /* 0..100，写入时被 clamp */
  bool     incomplete;
};
```
(VS_TEXT_SHORT=40, VS_TEXT_LONG=128，见 include/vs_types.h:65-66)

**vs_history_append() 事务流程（vs_history.c:1108-1227）**

签名：`int vs_history_append(enum vs_history_kind_e kind, struct vs_history_index_s *index, const char *full_json)` —— 注意 `index` 是**非 const 出入参**，成功后 `*index = entry`（第 1204 行附近），调用者由此拿到系统分配的 `record_key`。这是给"每条记录一个音频文件"取名的天然入口。

1. 参数校验；`cJSON_Parse(full_json)` 必须是 object，否则 -EBADMSG（解析只为校验，随即 delete）。
2. `malloc(MAX_RECORDS * sizeof entry)` 做候选索引数组。
3. 加 `g_history_lock`；`!g_kind_ready[kind]` → -ENODEV。
4. `vs_history_choose_seq_locked()`（749-778）：从 `g_next_seq[kind]` 起，最多探测 `MAX+1024` 次，要求该 key **既不在内存索引里、又 access(F_OK) 返回 ENOENT**（文件也不存在）才采用；到 SEQ_MAX 回绕 0；耗尽返回 -ENOSPC。
5. `vs_history_normalize_entry()`（780-807）：写 kind、按 seq 格式化 record_key、三段字符串强制 NUL 结尾、百分比 clamp 到 100。
6. 组装候选数组：`candidate[0] = 新条目`，其后 memcpy 旧条目。`evict = old_count >= CONFIG_VS_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS`（Kconfig 默认 **64**，per kind）；`new_count = evict ? MAX : old+1`，`copy_count = new_count-1` —— **满了就丢最旧的那条（下标 old_count-1）**，并先算出它的 body 路径。
7. 写正文：`vs_history_atomic_write(dir, R.TMP, R.JSN, json)`（365-403）= open(O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC,0600) → 全量 write → **fsync(fd)** → close → **rename()** → **fsync(dir)**（vs_history_sync_dir, 297-306）。任一步失败 unlink 临时文件。
8. 写索引：`vs_history_write_index_locked()`（507-556）把整个候选数组序列化成 cJSON 数组，长度校验后同样 TMP→rename→fsync 提交。**索引写失败则 unlink 刚写的新 body、fsync 目录、返回错误，旧索引与旧 body 完好**。
9. 提交内存：memcpy g_index、`g_count = new_count`、`g_next_seq = seq+1`（回绕）、`*index = entry`。
10. 最后 `unlink(evicted_path)`；失败只 printf 告警（留下孤儿文件，不把已持久化的 append 变成失败）。

断电语义：可能留下"没人引用的 body"，但绝不会出现"索引指向已删除 body"。

**记录 id 能否派生音频名**：可以，`record_key` 就是。它在记录整个生命周期内不变——淘汰只是删条目+删 body，**不会重排/重编号**；`g_next_seq` 单调前进（到 9999999 才回绕），所以短期内不会复用。两个坑：
- **社交种子记录 R0000000..R0000002** 会在 `VS_HISTORY_SOCIAL_SEED_VERSION` 递增时用同样的 key 重写（vs_history.c:57-60, 680-715），即 key 会被"复用"到新内容。
- **淘汰时没有任何机制通知调用者被淘汰的 key**（evicted_path 只在 vs_history.c 内部用），所以你新增的 `R*.WAV` 不会被清理。要么给 append 加一个 "evicted_key" 出参/回调，要么在启动/append 后扫目录，把不在索引里的 `R*.WAV` 删掉。另外 `g_history_dir[]` 是 static private，取音频目录需要新加一个访问器（例如 `vs_history_audio_path(kind, key, buf, len)`）或把音频放到自己的 config 目录下按 key 命名。

**读取侧 API（vs_history.h:56-90，实现行号见下）**

```c
bool         vs_history_is_ready(enum vs_history_kind_e kind);                 /* :930 */
unsigned int vs_history_count(enum vs_history_kind_e kind);                    /* :945 */
int          vs_history_get_index(kind, unsigned int index,
                                  struct vs_history_index_s *out);             /* :960  index 0 = 最新，越界 -ENOENT */
int          vs_history_snapshot(kind, unsigned int offset,
                                 struct vs_history_index_s *out, size_t cap,
                                 unsigned int *total, unsigned int *copied);   /* :980  锁内一致快照 */
int          vs_history_open_full(kind, const char *record_key,
                                 int *fd, size_t *size);                       /* :1014 严格校验 key + 成员校验，fd 定位 0 */
int          vs_history_read_full(kind, const char *record_key,
                                 char *buf, size_t len);                       /* :1067 放不下返回 -E2BIG，成功返回字节数 */
```
`get_index`/`count`/`snapshot` 全部只读内存、只加锁，不碰 SD-NAND，可在 UI 线程调用（vs_snapshot() 就是这么用的，vs_app.c:724,733）。`open_full`/`read_full` 会真读文件，属于 worker/Web 线程的活。

**SOCIAL 与 CHAT 不共用索引**：两者目录、INDEX.JSN、`g_index[]`/`g_count[]`/`g_next_seq[]`、key 空间、容量全部独立（vs_history.h:12-15 明确 "kind must always travel with the key"）。历史浏览页只读 SOCIAL；CHAT 由 vs_voice.c 的 `vs_voice_conv_persist()`（vs_voice.c:2531-2645，失败后 usleep 100 ms 重试一次）写入，只作为对话上下文回读。

另一个与功能(1)相关的边界：`vs_history_open()` 在 SD-NAND 不可用时会**只在内存里加载 social 样例**并返回错误（vs_history.c:848-856），此时 `g_kind_ready=false`，append/open_full 一律 -ENODEV。历史页照样能显示 3 条样例记录，但它们没有音频文件（种子 body 里 `ttsMinutes` 是空串），自动播放必须容忍"文件不存在"。

## B. 错误页与重试（vs_app.c）

**runtime 字段（vs_app.c:257-260）**
- `int error` —— errno；`vs_set_error()` 里 0 会被强制成 -EIO。
- `char error_reason[VS_TEXT_LONG]` —— 面向用户的中文原因，末尾带 " (errno)"。
- `bool error_retryable` —— 同时决定 ① 确认键是否显示"重试"② 确认键分支是否动作。
- `enum vs_net_mode_e error_target_mode` —— 重试要切到的网络模式；**只有网络类失败会设置它**（vs_app.c:1512, 1544, 主循环 2795 附近），社交失败路径根本不填。
- `enum vs_page_e error_return_page` —— 返回键去哪。

**vs_set_error()（vs_app.c:1561-1576）**：写 error/return_page/retryable；如果 `runtime->network.error == runtime->error` 且 network 层已有 reason 就复用它，否则 `vs_errno_reason(error) + " (%d)"`；最后 `runtime->page = VS_PAGE_ERROR`。**它不碰 error_target_mode**，调用方必须在调用前自己设。
**vs_set_error_reason()（vs_app.c:1336-1344）**：先调 vs_set_error()，再用给定文案覆盖 error_reason。

**VS_PAGE_ERROR 的按键分支（vs_app.c:2377-2404）**

```c
case VS_PAGE_ERROR:
  if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM && runtime->error_retryable && network != NULL)
    { mode = runtime->error_target_mode;
      runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING; runtime->progress = 100;
      ret = vs_start_network_worker(runtime, network, mode, false);
      if (ret < 0) { /* 改写 error/error_reason，留在 ERROR 页 */ } }
  else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
    runtime->page = runtime->error_return_page;
```
即**目前"重试"只有一种语义：以 `error_target_mode` 重跑网络切换 worker**（密码重置失败也走这条，因为 apply_ap() 顺带重新抽密码）。所有社交失败都传 `retryable=false`：stage 超时（1476/1483/1490）、START_FAILED（1662,1677）、摘要为空（1730）、**SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED（1756-1759，返回页 vs_browse_page()）**，所以"重试"键在社交错误上从不出现。

**错误页快照渲染（vs_app.c:1235-1248）**，在 `vs_snapshot()` 的 `case VS_PAGE_ERROR: default:` 里：
```
content_title "出了问题"
content_body  "%.80s\n%s"  (error_reason, retryable ? "短按重试或返回" : "短按返回")
status        "错误" / "未完成" / "请处理"
vs_key_set(BACK, "返回");  if (error_retryable) vs_key_set(CONFIRM, "重试");
```
软键文案全部来自 `vs_key_set()`（vs_app.c:657-663，写 `snapshot->softkey[key].visible/text`），vs_display.c 只负责画 `snapshot->softkey[]`。`snapshot->error_retryable` 也在 739 行同步过去；进度环在错误页被强制关掉（vs_display.c:482）。

**做功能(2)要注意的现状缺口**：`SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED` 事件发出后，session 线程已经走过 `social_finalize_sequence()`，紧接着 `social_log_totals(); social_release_devices(); goto done;`（vs_social.c:2797-2801），设备已释放、`g_social.running=false`；而云端会话在 sequence 开头就被 `vs_cloud_social_finalize()` 关过了。所以"重试"不能简单复用旧会话：需要新增一个 vs_social API（例如把 `session_id`+`msg_id` 留存、只重跑"轮询 getResult + social_persist_minutes"那段，见 vs_social.c:2497-2570），或者把重试定义成"重新发起会话"。同时 ERROR 页的 CONFIRM 分支现在硬编码为网络 worker，需要引入一个"重试类型"（新枚举字段，或复用 error_target_mode + 一个 kind 标志）来分流。

## C. 主循环节拍与定时（vs_app.c:2559-2845）

- 一轮结尾 `usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000)`（vs_app.c:2842），`CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS` **默认 5**（Kconfig:32-35）；输入 worker 任务用同一间隔轮询按键（vs_app.c:199）。所以 UI 线程约 5 ms 一轮（加上当轮工作耗时；社交时相机熵校验会抢核 200+ ms，注释里多处提到）。
- 每轮顺序：response 高亮到期（2703-2712）→ **社交 stage 截止时间的 arm/disarm/enforce（2718-2740）** → 取输入事件（≤VS_INPUT_EVENTS_PER_FRAME）→ 取 app 事件（≤8）→ 网络事件 → **wifi 重试截止（2825-2838）** → `vs_display_tick()` → `pending_save` 落盘（2830-2841，先 flush 再阻塞写）→ usleep。
- **可以照抄的"到期时间戳"模式**有三处，全是 `uint32_t 绝对毫秒 + (int32_t)(deadline - now) <= 0` 的回绕安全比较：
  - `runtime.social_stage_until_ms`（声明 288；集中 arm/清零/超时在 2718-2740，预算函数 vs_social_stage_budget_ms 1440-1444，超时动作 vs_social_stage_timeout 1467-1499）—— 注释明确说"集中在循环里判断，避免后加的 handler 忘记 arm"，这正是"历史页停留 2 秒"最该照抄的形态：由 `page/index` 推导，而不是在每个按键分支里 arm。
  - `runtime.wifi_retry_at_ms`（设值 457，检查 2825-2838，`VS_WIFI_RETRY_MS 20000`）。
  - `runtime.response_until_ms` + `response_pending_visible`（279-282, 1265-1293），`VS_RESPONSE_VISIBLE_MS 200`。
- `vs_app_now_ms()`（vs_app.c:205-211）：
```c
static uint32_t vs_app_now_ms(void)
{ struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
  return (uint32_t)(ts.tv_sec * 1000u + ts.tv_nsec / 1000000u); }
```
- **历史浏览按键分支**：`case VS_PAGE_HISTORY:`（vs_app.c:2004-2110）——CONFIRM 用当前 `runtime->index` 取记录并启动 `VS_VOICE_CTX_RECORD` 语音；NEXT 到尾部转 `VS_PAGE_VOLUME`，否则 `runtime->index++`；BACK 到 0 则 `history_blank = true` + `page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK`，否则 `runtime->index--`。`case VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK:`（2108-2170）与 `case VS_PAGE_VOLUME:`（2172-2220）在环形翻页时也会改 `history_blank`/`index`。另外 `vs_show_newest_record()`（1408-1422）在 SOCIAL_RESULT 到达时把 `index=0, history_blank=false`；SOCIAL_RESULT 页退出（2337-2350）走 `vs_browse_page()`（1386-1389，`history_blank ? HISTORY_BLANK : HISTORY`）。
  → 结论：自动播放的"停留计时"应以 **(runtime.page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY, runtime.index)** 这对值为 key，变化即重置计时并停播；`history_blank` 只是页面选择器。

## D. 播放 API 的线程契约与可复用实现

**契约（include/vs_audio.h 头注释 "Threading contract"，约 44-52 行）**：`open/start/read/write/drain/close` 属于**同一个 owning thread**；只有 `vs_audio_capture_abort()` 和 `vs_audio_playback_stop()` 可跨线程调用，且必须在 owner 仍持有 handle 期间——owner 必须先停止发布指针再 `close()`。所以 **UI 线程绝不能自己 open/write/drain/close**，只能对"已发布的 handle"调 stop。语义细节（vs_audio.h:186-247）：`playback_write` 只在 ring 满时阻塞（背压，不是实时节拍），stop 之后返回 -ECANCELED；`playback_drain` 会在 stop 时提前返回、且驱动无进展时自行放弃（不会挂死）；`playback_close` 会丢弃未播内容，要留尾音就先 drain；`playback_underruns` 报饥饿次数。

**现成"后台喂 DAC + UI 随时停"的两份实现，都可以照抄：**

1. **vs_voice.c 的 TTS 播放路径 `vs_voice_speak()`（vs_voice.c:2241-2318）**：voice worker 线程 `vs_audio_playback_open(AGENT_AUDIO_PLAYBACK_DEV, AGENT_TTS_WS_SAMPLE_RATE, AGENT_VOICE_CHANNELS, AGENT_VOICE_BITS)` → 在 `g_voice.lock` 下把 handle 发布到 `g_voice.pb` 并置 stage=SPEAKING → TTS chunk 回调里 `vs_audio_playback_write()`（2226）→ `vs_audio_playback_drain()`（2291，注释说明"handle 故意保持发布，这正是用户按退出能切掉尾音的窗口"）→ 锁内 `g_voice.pb = NULL` → `vs_audio_playback_close()`。UI 线程侧在 vs_voice.c:3135 / 3183 / 3204 三处取锁后 `vs_audio_playback_stop(g_voice.pb)`。**这就是"UI 触发、后台播放、随时停止"的标准骨架。**

2. **vs_social.c 的文件→DAC 循环 `social_play_minutes_audio()`（vs_social.c:2288-2455）**，与解析器 `social_wav_open()`（2119-2250，走 RIFF chunk 链、返回定位到 PCM 的 fd 及 rate/channels/bits/data_len）+ `social_read_exact()`（2029-2058）+ `social_minutes_dir()`（2065-2090）。流程：`vs_cloud_download_to_file(url, CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_MINUTES_AUDIO_PATH, CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES, &file_len)` → `social_wav_open()` → 8 KB PSRAM 缓冲（`SOCIAL_PLAY_CHUNK 8192`，vs_social.c:130）→ `vs_audio_playback_open(AGENT_AUDIO_PLAYBACK_DEV, rate, channels, bits)` → 每 chunk 先查 `g_social.abort`（锁内读），要中止就 `vs_audio_playback_stop(pb); break;` → `read()` → `vs_audio_playback_write()` → 循环结束 `drain` + underrun 日志 + `close`。它跑在 session 线程（`VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL = SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT - 5`，vs_types.h:57），全程 best-effort、只打日志不上抛。

**没有通用的"播放某个 WAV 文件"模块**——上面两个都是各自文件里的 static 函数。功能(1)需要新建一个小模块（例如 vs_hist_audio.c）：一个后台线程 + `pthread_mutex` 保护的 `pb` 指针与 `abort` 标志 + `vs_hist_audio_play(record_key)` / `vs_hist_audio_stop()`，把 social_wav_open + chunk 循环搬过去。优先级建议 `SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT-5`（与 social 一致，低于 UI）或 `VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO`（vs_types.h:27，DEFAULT+10）——注意 vs_types.h:34-56 的注释解释了为什么 social 的线程被特意压到 UI 之下。

**功能(1)必须知道的两个硬约束**：
- 采样率：本板只能 8000/16000/32000 Hz、16 bit、单声道（vs_audio.h 头注释 "Hardware limits"），24 kHz 会被 `vs_audio_params_valid()` 拒掉。而 Kconfig:663-666 和 vs_social.c:2361-2366 记录了 2026-09-04 实测云端 `ttsMinutes` 是 **24 kHz** RIFF/WAVE、48000 B/s。所以历史页重播时同样可能开不了 DAC，需要按名报错或在下载时重采样。
- 体积：最短一条实测 585 KB / 12.5 s，`CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_DOWNLOAD_MAX_BYTES` 是文件上限（Kconfig:654-679）。改成每条一个文件后，64 条 × 数百 KB 会真实占用 SD-NAND，加上淘汰时没人删音频（见 A 节），必须自己做配额/清理。
- 时效：`ttsMinutes` 是预签名 URL，只有 1 小时有效（vs_social.c:2585-2588 注释），所以"每条一个文件"必须在 finalize 当次下载好，不能事后按需拉取。落地点最自然是把 `social_persist_minutes()`（vs_social.c:1948-1989，它已经通过 `*index` 拿到了分配好的 record_key）的返回 key 传给 `social_play_minutes_audio()`，用它拼路径替换固定的 `CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_MINUTES_AUDIO_PATH`（vs_social.c:2290）。

  1. app/velasight/vs_history.c — 完整存储模型：目录/8.3 命名、seq 分配、原子写与索引提交、64 条上限与淘汰、全部读取 API

I'm mapping out a comprehensive solution here. The key insight is creating a dedicated module to handle background WAV playback that both the social finalize path and history browse can share, eliminating duplication and providing safe cross-thread control from the UI.

The module exposes a clean API for opening the worker thread, queuing playback, stopping, checking status, and shutting down. Internally it uses a persistent worker thread that manages the playback state—tracking the current file path, a generation counter to detect when new requests arrive, and stop flags—all protected by locks. When play is called, it copies the path, increments the generation, and signals the worker; the worker then opens and parses the WAV, initializes the DAC, feeds chunks while watching for generation changes or stop signals, then drains and closes. I'm leaning toward running this at social priority since it's just file I/O and DAC feeding with a ring buffer absorbing the writes, so latency isn't critical and the UI stays responsive.

One key constraint I need to handle: social playback and history playback must never overlap since there's only one DAC. Since vs_tts owns all WAV playback through a single worker, that's already enforced. But if the user presses confirm on a history record to start a voice question while auto-play is running, I need to stop the auto-play first—I'll add vs_tts_stop calls at those decision points.

For storing per-record audio files, I'm planning to put them in the history directory as R0000123.WAV, but since g_history_dir is private, I need to add a helper function to vs_history that constructs the audio path for a given record.

I'm weighing whether the session thread calls `vs_tts_play()` right after posting (simpler, keeps things in one place) versus having the UI thread start playback when it receives SOCIAL_RESULT (more explicit timing). Option (a) is cleaner since the post and play happen microseconds apart anyway, effectively simultaneous from the user's perspective.

There's a wrinkle though: if the user navigates from RESULT back to HISTORY at index 0, the dwell timer might try to replay the same audio file while it's still playing from the social post, causing an interruption. I can solve this elegantly by having `vs_tts_play()` track the currently-playing path and become a no-op if that same file is already playing. That way the playback just continues uninterrupted when the dwell timer fires on the same record.

I also need to handle page transitions: when moving between history records or leaving the history pages entirely (to social, voice, softap, volume), the playback should stop. The dwell logic will compute a "desired path" based on the current page and index; if it differs from what's playing, stop and restart the timer. If we're not on a history record page at all, stop immediately.

/****************************************************************************
 * app/velasight/include/vs_tts.h
 *
 * One owner for "speak this WAV file", shared by the two places that need it.
 *
 * Why a module rather than a function
 * ----------------------------------
 * Two callers want the same thing from opposite sides of the threading rules.
 * The social session, having just downloaded the spoken minutes, wants to
 * start playback and get on with tearing itself down.  The history page wants
 * to start playback of whatever record the user has settled on, and to stop it
 * the moment they move -- and the history page *is* the UI thread, which
 * vs_audio.h forbids from doing anything but stop() on a playback handle.
 *
 * Neither can be served by a blocking call.  So the file reading and the DAC
 * feeding live on one worker thread here, and both callers only ever hand over
 * a path or ask for silence.
 *
 * It also makes the mutual exclusion real.  There is one DAC, one worker and
 * one file at a time, so a session's minutes and a browsed record cannot end
 * up interleaved on the speaker -- which is exactly what two independent
 * copies of the same loop would have allowed.
 *
 * Restarting the same file is deliberately not restarting
 * ------------------------------------------------------
 * vs_tts_play() with the path that is already playing does nothing and reports
 * success.  That is what makes the two callers compose: a session posts its
 * result, playback starts, and the user immediately backs out of the result
 * page onto the history entry that session just wrote.  The dwell timer then
 * asks for that record's audio -- the same file -- and without this rule the
 * user would hear the first two seconds again.
 *
 * Threading
 * ---------
 * Every function here is safe to call from the UI thread and returns without
 * waiting for audio.  vs_tts_close() is the one exception and is for shutdown.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 ****************************************************************************/

#ifndef __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_TTS_H
#define __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_TTS_H

#include <stdbool.h>

/* Long enough for the history store's own paths, which are the only ones this
 * is asked to play: VS_HISTORY_PATH_MAX is 96.
 */

#define VS_TTS_PATH_MAX 128

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vs_tts_open
 *
 * Description:
 *   Start the playback worker.  Opens no device -- the DAC is opened per file,
 *   because the sample rate comes out of the file's own header -- so this is
 *   cheap and safe on the startup path.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   0, or a negative errno when the thread could not be created.  A failure
 *   is not fatal to the application: every later call becomes a no-op that
 *   reports -ENODEV, and the only thing lost is spoken output.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vs_tts_open(void);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vs_tts_play
 *
 * Description:
 *   Play one RIFF/WAVE file, replacing whatever is playing.  Returns as soon
 *   as the request is handed to the worker; the file is opened, parsed and
 *   fed to the DAC there.
 *
 *   Asking for the file that is already playing is a no-op -- see the header
 *   comment for why that rule exists rather than being an optimisation.
 *
 *   Only 16-bit PCM at 8000, 16000 or 32000 Hz can be played; this board's
 *   audio block cannot reach other rates (see vs_audio.h).  A file at any
 *   other rate is refused by name in the log rather than played at the wrong
 *   pitch.
 *
 * Returned Value:
 *   0 when accepted or already playing.  -ENODEV when the worker is not
 *   running, -EINVAL for an empty path, -ENAMETOOLONG when the path does not
 *   fit VS_TTS_PATH_MAX.  Anything wrong with the *file* is reported in the
 *   log rather than here, because by the time it is discovered this call has
 *   long returned.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

int vs_tts_play(const char *path);

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: vs_tts_stop
 *
 * Description:
 *   Silence the speaker and forget the request.  Safe to call when nothing is
 *   playing, and safe to call repeatedly -- the history page does exactly that
 *   on every navigation.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void vs_tts_stop(void);

/* True while a file is open and being fed to the DAC.  For the UI to show that
 * something is speaking, and for shutdown to know whether it is waiting on
 * anything.
 */

bool vs_tts_busy(void);

/* Copy the path being played into out, or leave it empty when idle.  Lets a
 * caller decide whether the file it is about to ask for is already the one on
 * the speaker without depending on this module's own comparison.
 */

void vs_tts_current(char *out, size_t len);

/* Stop playback, join the worker and release everything.  Blocking; for
 * shutdown only.  Safe when vs_tts_open() failed or was never called.
 */

void vs_tts_close(void);

#endif /* __APP_VELASIGHT_INCLUDE_VS_TTS_H */

 * Name: social_wav_le16 / social_wav_le32
 *
 * Description:
 *   Read a little-endian field out of a RIFF header without assuming the
 *   host's byte order or that the field is aligned.  Both hold on this chip,
 *   and neither is worth depending on for eight lines of code.
 *

static uint16_t social_wav_le16(const unsigned char *p)
{
  return (uint16_t)((uint16_t)p[0] | ((uint16_t)p[1] << 8));
}

static uint32_t social_wav_le32(const unsigned char *p)
{
  return (uint32_t)p[0] | ((uint32_t)p[1] << 8) |
         ((uint32_t)p[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)p[3] << 24);
}

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: social_read_exact
 *
 * Description:
 *   read() that either fills the buffer or says why it could not.  Short
 *   reads are normal on a file and a header parser that treated one as an
 *   error would fail on a perfectly good WAV.
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

static int social_read_exact(int fd, void *buf, size_t len)
{
  unsigned char *p = buf;
  size_t off = 0;

  while (off < len)
    {
      ssize_t n = read(fd, p + off, len - off);

      if (n < 0)
        {
          if (errno == EINTR)
            {
              continue;
            }

          return -errno;
        }

      if (n == 0)
        {
          return -ENODATA;
        }

      off += (size_t)n;
    }

  return 0;
}

static void social_finalize_sequence(void)
{
  struct vs_cloud_minutes_s minutes;
  char msg_id[VS_CLOUD_MSG_ID_MAX];
  char *body = NULL;
  bool body_psram = false;
  uint64_t deadline;
  int ret;

  social_stop_producers();

  ret = vs_cloud_social_finalize(g_social.session.session_id, msg_id,
                                 sizeof(msg_id));
  if (ret < 0)
    {
      printf("%s: finalize failed: %d\n", SOCIAL_TAG, ret);
      social_post(VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED, ret, VS_EMOTION_NONE,
                  0, NULL);
      return;
    }

  body = (char *)social_alloc(CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_RESP_MAX_BYTES, &body_psram);
  if (body == NULL)
    {
      social_post(VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED, -ENOMEM,
                  VS_EMOTION_NONE, 0, NULL);
      return;
    }

  /* Poll rather than one long call.  vs_cloud_social_get_result() is
   * deliberately single-shot so this loop stays responsive; a call that
   * blocked for the whole timeout could not be interrupted, and the user may
   * press back again.
   */

  deadline = social_now_ms() + CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_TIMEOUT_MS;

  for (; ; )
    {
      bool aborting;

      ret = vs_cloud_social_get_result(g_social.session.session_id, msg_id,
                                       &minutes, body,
                                       CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_RESP_MAX_BYTES);
      if (ret != -EAGAIN)
        {
          break;
        }

      pthread_mutex_lock(&g_social.lock);
      aborting = g_social.abort;
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_social.lock);

      if (aborting)
        {
          social_free((unsigned char *)body, body_psram);
          return;
        }

      if (social_now_ms() >= deadline)
        {
          printf("%s: minutes did not arrive within %d ms\n", SOCIAL_TAG,
                 CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_TIMEOUT_MS);
          ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
          break;
        }

      usleep(CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_POLL_INTERVAL_MS * 1000);
    }

 * Name: vs_social_retry_finalize
 *
 * Description:

 *   all three are safe to do again.
 *
 *   Not available for a finalize that failed before the close was accepted --
 *   there is no msgId to poll then, and the honest answer is that the

Checking the build now to catch any compile errors. Before that, I'm reviewing `vs_tts_worker` more carefully — there's a potential issue with how `active` gets cleared after `vs_tts_play_file()` returns, specifically when generation doesn't match the wanted value.

This means `vs_tts_busy()` would return true forever and subsequent `vs_tts_play()` calls would be no-ops. The fix is to clear `active` unconditionally after the play finishes — since `active` is only written during adoption (which happens after the previous play returns on the same thread), there's no concurrent writer to worry about clobbering.

I'm also checking a few edge cases: `vs_tts_stop()` early-returning when both wanted and active are empty (fixed by the unconditional clear), the worker checking `g_tts.active` between file transitions (safe), and `vs_tts_play_file` publishing the playback object only after successfully opening it (correct — it skips publishing on error paths). The worker thread will break out of its loop when quit becomes true, then return after clearing the active flag. The status message prints correctly, and now I need to apply the fix for the active-clearing bug.

      /* Cleared unconditionally, and that has to be unconditional.
       *
       * Guarding it with "only if the generation still matches" looks safer and
       * is the opposite: a stop bumps the generation, so the guard would skip
       * the clear and leave active naming a file that is no longer playing.
       * From then on vs_tts_busy() reports true forever and vs_tts_play() of
       * that same file is a permanent no-op -- the record would never speak
       * again until a reboot.
       *
       * There is no race to guard against anyway.  active is only ever written
       * here and at adoption above, both on this thread, and a newer request
       * lives in wanted until this loop comes back round for it.

      pthread_mutex_lock(&g_tts.lock);
      g_tts.active[0] = '\0';
      pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_tts.lock);

text:
四个功能都实现了，固件构建通过，velasight 全部源文件零告警。

## 新模块：vs_tts

`app/velasight/vs_tts.c` + `include/vs_tts.h`。一个常驻 worker 线程负责"读 WAV 喂 DAC"，两个调用方都只交路径或要静音。之前这段代码在 vs_social.c 里跑在 session 线程上，只服务一个调用方；搬出来同时解决三件事：session 线程不再在收尾里耗掉音频时长、历史页第一次有了播放能力、两者不可能同时抢 DAC（中间只有一个 worker）。

关键契约是 **同路径重复 play 为 no-op**。这是让两个调用方能组合的前提：会话播完摘要把用户丢在结果页，用户按返回落到刚写的那条历史记录上，停留计时器请求的正是同一个文件 —— 没有这条规则就会重播开头两秒。

停止和切换是同一个操作：每次请求 bump generation，喂 DAC 的循环每片比对，不一致就退出。UI 线程只调 `vs_tts_stop()`，符合 vs_audio.h 的线程契约（只有 stop 可跨线程）。

## 1. FINALIZING 覆盖到 TTS 接收完成

`social_collect_minutes()` 的顺序改成：轮询 → **保存** → **下载音频** → post RESULT → `vs_tts_play()`。下载挪到 post 之前，所以页面一直停在"正在…"直到真的没有东西可等；页面切换和第一声同时发生。

音频改成每条记录一个文件：`vs_history_audio_path()` 给出 `<social dir>/R0000123.WAV`，8.3 安全（`R`+7 位正好 8 字符）。命名放在 vs_history 里而不是暴露目录，因为淘汰时要删它 —— `vs_history_append()` 淘汰旧记录时现在连 `.WAV` 一起 unlink，否则 64 条几百 KB 的孤儿文件就是保留上限存在的意义本身。

原来的固定路径 `CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_MINUTES_AUDIO_PATH` 随之删除。

## 2. 阶段化日志与阶段文案

五个阶段：`STOPPING / CLOSING / WAITING / SAVING / FETCHING`。每次进入打两行日志（上一阶段耗时 + 本阶段的 t+ 累计），并投一个 `VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STAGE` 更新左屏中层：

```
正在停止采集 → 正在通知云端 → 正在生成建议 → 正在保存记录 → 正在接收语音
```

这顺带补上了 UI 文档 5.6 要求的三段显示（原来"正在生成建议"一句话罩住全程，包括在停相机和写卡的时候）。

**看门狗改成按阶段。** STAGE 事件把 `social_stage_until_ms` 清零，主循环下一轮用新阶段的预算重新武装 —— 从"总时长上限"变成"无进展检测"。预算：WAITING 80 s（轮询 60+20）、FETCHING 110 s（下载 90+20）、其余 40 s。原来一个 80 s 罩住全部，既抓不到单步卡死又会掐掉只是慢的云端（那次实测只剩 2.6 s 余量）。

失败和超时的文案现在带阶段：`云端未给出建议` / `保存记录失败` / `接收语音无响应` 等。

## 3. 获取结果失败的重试按钮

新增 `vs_social_retry_finalize()` / `vs_social_can_retry()`。只重跑可重复的后半段：DELETE 已经被云端接受、msgId 已经拿到，之后的轮询、落盘、下载都读的是还在的状态。close 之前就失败的不给重试 —— 那时没有 msgId 可查，诚实的答案是这次对话没了。

错误页原来的"重试"只有一种含义（用 `error_target_mode` 重跑网络 worker），所以社交失败一律 `retryable=false`。现在加了 `enum vs_retry_kind_e`，`vs_set_error()` 默认 NETWORK（所有既有调用方都是这个意思），社交路径事后覆盖成 SOCIAL。按下后回到 FINALIZING 页重走阶段流程。

按太快会撞上 `-EBUSY`（上次的线程还在退栈），此时给一个瞬时软键提示"稍等"而不是第二个错误页 —— `vs_social_can_retry()` 故意不检查 `running`，否则在失败上报的那一刻它永远返回 false，键就永远不会出现。

## 4. 历史页停留 2 秒自动播放

`vs_update_record_audio()` 在主循环里按 `(page, index)` 推导，而不是在按键分支里 arm —— 有五处会移动浏览选择，加第六处的人一定会忘。三种情况：

| 页面显示的 | 动作 |
| --- | --- |
| 正在播的那个文件 | 不动 |
| 别的记录 | 停当前 + 起 2 s 计时 |
| 没有记录（空白页/音量页/任何模态页） | 停 |

中间那条就是上面说的 no-op 契约在起作用。离开浏览环（进社交、按确认发起语音问答）都会停播，顺带避免了和语音助手抢 DAC。


## 需要你知道的

**没有烧录、没有上板。** 以下都是静态实现，我只验证了编译和打包：

- 24 kHz 仍然会在 `vs_audio_params_valid()` 被拒（按你的决定等云端换 16 kHz）。在那之前，阶段流程会走完、记录和 WAV 都会落盘、结果页会出摘要，只是 `vs_tts` 会打一行 `cannot open the speaker at 24000 Hz`。历史页自动播放同理。
- 已有的 9 条历史记录（含 3 条种子）没有 `.WAV` 文件，停留时会打一行 `has no audio`，这是预期行为不是故障。
- 崩溃或旧固件遗留的孤儿 `.WAV`（不在索引里的）没有清理机制，只在正常淘汰路径上删。要补需要开机扫一遍目录。
- 结果页按键仍然不停播报（上一轮就存在，这次没动）—— 不过现在离开结果页进到历史页时，`vs_update_record_audio()` 会因为"正在播的就是这条"而让它继续播完，这是设计如此。

上板验证时值得看的日志：`vs_social: finalize: <stage> took N ms` 五行、`vs_social: record R000xxx saved`、`vs_social: spoken minutes saved to .../R000xxx.WAV, N bytes in M ms`、`vs_social: finalize complete in N ms`，然后浏览历史时的 `vs_tts: playing ...` 与 `vs_tts: stopped after N of M bytes`。

烧录命令：`./build_and_flash.sh --flash -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1`。

WAITING 52.65 s（云端）+ FETCHING 64.62 s（下载，最终失败）占了 91%。设备侧只占 STOPPING 3.1 s + SAVING 8.4 s + 响应 1.1 s ≈ 12.6 s。想把这个数字压下来，得先解决 P3；P1/P2/P4 影响的是结果质量而不是时长。

<file name="app/velasight/vs_cloud.c" language="plaintext" >
<content>
 ****************************************************************************/

/* One progress line every this many bytes.  A 500 KB download becomes four
 * lines, which is the difference between "stalled at 128 KB" and "silent for
 * twenty seconds and then failed" -- two things that look the same in a log
 * that only reports the outcome.
 */

#define CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_REPORT_STRIDE (128 * 1024)

struct cloud_file_sink_s
{
  int fd;
  size_t written;
  size_t max_bytes;
  size_t next_report;
  bool over;   /* refused because the budget was reached */
  int err;     /* errno from write(), 0 when there was none */
};

static int cloud_file_sink(void *arg, const void *data, size_t len)
{
  struct cloud_file_sink_s *sink = arg;
  const unsigned char *p = data;
  size_t off = 0;

  /* Checked before writing, not after.  Stopping once the file is already too
   * large would still have spent the storage.
   */

  if (sink->written + len > sink->max_bytes)
    {
      sink->over = true;
      return -1;
    }

  while (off < len)
    {
      ssize_t n = write(sink->fd, p + off, len - off);

      if (n < 0)
        {
          if (errno == EINTR)
            {
              continue;
            }

          sink->err = errno;
          return -1;
        }

      if (n == 0)
        {
          /* A short write of nothing is how a full filesystem shows up on
           * some drivers, and looping on it would spin forever.
           */

          sink->err = ENOSPC;
          return -1;
        }

      off += (size_t)n;
    }

  sink->written += len;

  if (sink->written >= sink->next_report)
    {
      printf("%s: download %zu bytes\n", CLOUD_TAG, sink->written);
      sink->next_report = sink->written + CLOUD_DOWNLOAD_REPORT_STRIDE;
    }

  return 0;
}

/* One read from storage and one write to the DAC per iteration.
 *
 * Sized against the card rather than against the audio.  This is FAT on
 * SD-NAND with a 1-bit bus, single-block PIO transfers and no write buffer or
 * read-ahead underneath (CONFIG_SDIO_WIDTH_D1_ONLY,
 * CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1), so a read costs a fixed amount of
 * per-call filesystem work plus one 512-byte command per sector -- and a read
 * that is not sector-aligned pays to fetch the partial sectors at both ends.
 *
 * The constraint is that a chunk has to be read in less time than the chunk
 * lasts, or the DAC starves.  8 KB is only 250 ms of 16 kHz mono, and the
 * same storage measured 0.77 s for a 1.4 KB write during a download, so 8 KB
 * left no margin at all: the 1 s pre-buffer would drain in the first few
 * reads and every one after that would be an underrun.
 *
 * 64 KB is 2 s of 16 kHz mono and 128 sectors exactly, which puts the
 * per-call overhead into the noise and gives the ring time to absorb a slow
 * read.  The cost is reaction time: a stop is acted on at chunk boundaries,
 * so it is felt within one chunk's read rather than instantly.  That is the
 * right trade here because vs_audio_playback_stop() silences the DAC
 * immediately and independently -- the loop leaving late only delays the file
 * being closed, which nobody hears.
 */

#ifndef CONFIG_VS_TTS_CHUNK_BYTES
#  define CONFIG_VS_TTS_CHUNK_BYTES 65536
#endif

#define VS_TTS_CHUNK CONFIG_VS_TTS_CHUNK_BYTES

修好了两个真正的 I/O 性能问题，补了一个缺失的诊断。改动全部在 `app/velasight/`。

## 修复一：下载写盘放大（你指的那个 ~1s 单次 IO）

根因是两层的接缝。`vela_tls.c:822-843` 的流式循环里：

```c
size_t want = TLS_RAW_BUF_SIZE;              /* 8192 */
ret = mbedtls_ssl_read(&ctx->ssl, raw, want);
if (ret > 0) sink(sink_arg, raw, (size_t)ret);
```

`mbedtls_ssl_read()` 一次最多返回**一个 TLS 记录**，不管给它多大缓冲 —— 1500 字节 MTU 下约 1.4 KB。而 `cloud_file_sink()` 对每次 sink 调用做一次 `write()`。下面是 FAT on SD-NAND，defconfig 里 `CONFIG_SDIO_WIDTH_D1_ONLY=y`、`CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1`、没有 `CONFIG_SDIO_DMA`、也没有 `CONFIG_DRVR_WRITEBUFFER`。所以每次 1.4 KB 写都在 512 字节扇区上两头错位，FAT 把两个残缺扇区读回来改再写回去，下一条记录又把同一个尾扇区读一遍。

算术核对上一次日志：114054 B ÷ 1400 ≈ 81 次 write，62.6 s ÷ 81 ≈ **0.77 s/次**，1.82 KB/s。同一会话里 17 次上传到同一台主机、同一个连接池跑 ~24 KB/s，而上传不写盘。连接最后是被对端切断的：`ssl_read (stream) ret=0x4c`，格式串打的是 `-ret`，所以 `ret = -0x4C = MBEDTLS_ERR_NET_RECV_FAILED`。

改法：`cloud_file_sink()` 增加一个 PSRAM 聚合缓冲，只在满块时落盘，尾块由 `vs_cloud_download_to_file()` 在传输成功后单独 flush。块大小 `CONFIG_VS_SOCIAL_DOWNLOAD_BLOCK_BYTES` 默认 32768 = 64 个扇区，**是 512 的整数倍才是重点** —— 每次写都扇区对齐、扇区整数大小，残缺扇区的读改写完全消失。

同样的 114 KB 现在是 4 次写而不是 81 次。缓冲分配失败时退回逐记录直写（慢但正确），并打日志说明。

新增一行取证日志，专门用来区分"卡慢"和"网慢"：

```
vs_cloud: <path> written in 4 write(s) of up to 32768 bytes
```

## 修复二：播放读盘欠供

`vs_tts` 原来每次 `read(fd, buf, 8192)`。8 KB 只有 **250 ms** 的 16 kHz 单声道音频，而同一存储上 1.4 KB 写测到 0.77 s。播放缓冲是 655360 B ring + 1000 ms prebuffer，也就是 1 秒起播余量 —— 8 KB 的粒度会在头几次读之后就把它抽干，之后持续 underrun。585 KB 的文件要读 72 次。

`VS_TTS_CHUNK` 改成 `CONFIG_VS_TTS_CHUNK_BYTES`，默认 65536 = 2 秒音频 = 128 个扇区。代价是停止的响应粒度变成一个块，但这不影响听感：`vs_audio_playback_stop()` 是立即静音的，读循环晚退出只是文件晚关。

同时把读耗时打出来，让"卡慢"可归因：

```
vs_tts: finished after N of M bytes, 9 read(s) took 1200 ms for 12480 ms of audio, 0 underrun(s)
```

读时间对播放时间，一行答完"有没有欠供"和"是不是卡的问题"两个问题。

## 修复三：音频缺块的诊断

上一次 27.5 s 采集只产出 6 块（应约 13 块），`0 audio dropped`，日志里没有任何线索。现在 `social_stop_producers()` 在音频线程 join 之后、释放句柄之前打印 `vs_audio_capture_level()`：

```
vs_social: microphone: N samples (M ms), peak P rms R, X bytes dropped, Y settling, Z clipped
```

这四个计数把候选分开：`dropped` 是 staging ring 溢出（本模块读得太慢）、`settled` 是模拟前端稳定期丢弃、`clipped/samples` 是增益不对、全零而样本数偏低则是 ADC 本身没给够。位置是唯一能读到这些计数的窗口。

## 不能改的（在 board/，你限定了 app/）

- **相机 0.47 fps**（目标 2）：`validator avg=629 ms/frame`、`hw_busy=446`、`realign=301672571 cycles`，以及最可疑的 `core clock measured=13061 kHz configured=480000 kHz`。都在 `bk7258_camera_imgdata.c` / `bk7258_jpeg_enc.c`。这是云端只拿到 11 张图的直接原因。
- **每帧一行 `set_buf` printf**：`bk7258_camera_imgdata.c:2226`，经 mailbox 到 CP UART0。
- **存储栈本身**：1-bit、单块、PIO、无写缓冲，都是 defconfig 和 SDIO 驱动。我这次是在应用层绕开它的放大效应，不是让卡变快。

## 没改的（有意）

`vs_history_append()` 的 8.37 s。它是 17 次文件操作，其中 15 次是 fsync/rename/目录刷写。可以合并同步点把次数砍半，但那会破坏这个文件头注释里唯一的不变量 —— "绝不会出现索引指向已删除 body"。body 必须在 index 之前持久，两轮 fsync + rename 就是这个顺序保证本身。它一次会话只付一次，而且现在屏幕上写着"正在保存记录"。

云端时间线全空（`0 emotion / 0 audio samples`）是云端侧的事，设备侧 17 次上传零失败、图片结构合法。


`git status` 确认改动只在 `app/velasight/`；`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c` 和 `app/velasight/vs_voice.c` 的 M 标记是本次会话之前就存在的未提交改动，我没碰。

## 效果未验证

两个性能修复的机制是确定的（扇区对齐 + 减少系统调用次数），但**幅度我没有实测** —— 没烧录、没上板。如果下载吞吐改善后仍然很差，新加的 `written in N write(s)` 那行就是判据：写次数少而吞吐依旧低，说明瓶颈在网络下行而不在卡，那时候真正的对照实验是把同一个 URL 下载到 `/mnt/ram`（启动日志里已挂载的 2048 KB littlefs on PSRAM），完全绕开 NAND。

播放路径这次一次都没跑过（WAV 下载失败被 unlink 了），所以 64 KB 读块的效果要等一次成功的会话才能看到。

用户从长按到听到声音结束：**2 分 42 秒**（其中 30 s 是自己在读错误页）。

## 三个修复的实测效果

**写聚合生效，下载从 1.82 → 8.42 KB/s，且第一次跑完没被切断。**

```
vs_cloud: R0000013.WAV written in 7 write(s) of up to 32768 bytes
vs_social: spoken minutes saved ..., 199724 bytes in 23731 ms
```

7 次写代替了原来的约 140 次（199724 ÷ 1400）。4.6 倍提升，并且不再出现 `MBEDTLS_ERR_NET_RECV_FAILED` —— 对端不再因为设备长时间不读 socket 而重置连接。

**64 KB 读块生效**：`4 read(s)` 读完 199680 字节（原来 8 KB 块需要 25 次）。

**音频诊断给出了答案** —— 这是本次最有价值的一行，见下面第 4 节。

## 1. 确定性结论：这张卡的真实吞吐是 ~8.5-9 KB/s，双向

两个独立测量互相印证：

| 方向 | 数据 | 吞吐 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 写（下载落盘，7 次 32 KB 对齐写） | 199724 B / 23.73 s | **8.42 KB/s** |
| 读（播放，4 次 64 KB 读） | 199680 B / 22.47 s | **8.89 KB/s** |

两者几乎相同，说明已经触到 `CONFIG_SDIO_WIDTH_D1_ONLY` + `CONFIG_MMCSD_MULTIBLOCK_LIMIT=1` + 无 DMA 的天花板。**写聚合这条路已经走到尽头了**，剩下的空间在 board/（4-bit 总线、CMD25 多块、DMA），不在 app/。

同时这修正了我上一轮的一个判断：我说"读比写快得多，索引加载 14 ms 就是证据"。实测读 8.89 KB/s，和写一样慢。那 14 ms 大概是 FAT 扇区缓存命中，不是真实吞吐。

## 2. 硬结论：从 SD-NAND 直接播 16 kHz 音频不可能

```
vs_tts: finished after 199680 of 199680 bytes, 4 read(s) took 22467 ms
        for 6240 ms of audio, 2 underrun(s)
vs_audio: playback watermark 1000 -> 2000 ms after 2 underrun(s)
```

16 kHz 单声道 16-bit 需要 **32000 B/s**，卡只给 **8888 B/s** —— 差 3.6 倍。读一个文件的时间是它播放时长的 3.6 倍。这不是块大小能解决的问题，加大块只能减少调用次数，不能提高吞吐。

这次只响了 2 次 underrun 是运气：文件只有 6.2 s，而 ring 是 640 KB（20 s），所以整份音频最终都进了 ring；vs_audio 的自适应水位又从 1000 ms 抬到 2000 ms。一旦文件长到 20 s 以上（超过 ring 容量），就会变成持续断续。

可行的方向只有一个：**播放前把整份音频读进内存，读完再开 DAC**。代价是首声延迟等于读盘时间（本次 22.5 s），换来零 underrun。或者反过来接受断续。这是个产品取舍，需要你定，我没有动。

顺带：云端已经换成 **16000 Hz** 了（`playing ..., 16000 Hz 1 ch`），所以之前撤销的 24 kHz 重采样确实不需要了。

## 3. 音频丢了 45%，定位到了

```
vs_social: microphone: 1127424 samples (70464 ms), peak 32726 rms 545,
           1009152 bytes dropped, 0 settling, 289 clipped
```

拆开看：

- ADC 交付 **70.46 s** 音频，采集窗口约 74 s → **麦克风和驱动是好的**
- **1009152 字节被 staging ring 溢出丢弃** = 504576 样本 = **31.5 s**，占交付量的 45%
- `0 settling` → 不是前端稳定期的问题
- 社交侧实际消费：18 块 × 64000 B = 1152000 B。1152000 + 1009152 = 2161152，对上交付的 2254848 B（差额是 ring 里的余量）

所以上一轮"6 块 vs 13 块"的谜团是：**社交音频 worker 读得比麦克风给得慢，一半的声音在 `CONFIG_VS_AUDIO_CAPTURE_RING_BYTES`（131072 B = 4 s）里被覆盖掉了。**

worker 跑在 `VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL`（默认 −5 = 95），和采集 worker、上传 worker 同优先级，都在 UI（100）之下。而采集 worker 每帧要在 `vs_media_stream_grab()` 里等驱动的熵校验（`validator avg=468 ms`），那 468 ms 是同优先级的非让出计算，直接推迟音频 worker。加上上传 worker 前期每次 3099 ms 的 TLS，三个 95 优先级线程互相挤。

这解释了为什么云端音频时间线是空的 —— 它拿到的是一半带洞的音频。

另外 `peak 32726 / rms 545 / 289 clipped` 是另一个问题：峰值几乎满刻度还削了 289 个样本，而 rms 只有 545（约 −35 dBFS）。瞬态过载 + 语音过轻，增益设置不对。

```
frames=34 elapsed=74318ms measured=0.45 fps
sampler_skipped=35 hw_busy=1249          (上次 446)
validator runs=34 total_ticks=15921 avg=468 ms   (上次 629 ms)
realign=542551296257659035                (上次 301672571)
core clock measured=17719 kHz configured=480000 kHz
resets=1  jpeg err=1 last_status=0x00000002  yuv err_status=0x00000040
```

`core clock measured` 从 13061 变成 17719 kHz，两次都远离配置的 480000 —— 这个 27 倍差值是最值得单独查的一点，它同时解释了熵校验为什么贵、JSON 为什么慢、卡为什么慢（PIO 是 CPU 搬字节）。全部在 board/，我改不了。

`hw_busy=1249` 涨了 2.8 倍，是这次采集窗口更长（74 s vs 27.5 s）的自然结果。

上一轮 `image interval 500 ms` 全程没动，因为相机太慢从没喂满环。这次前 10 次上传平均 3099 ms，环（2 槽）被填满，于是：

```
dropped 1 → 1000 ms → dropped 4 → 2000 ms → ... dropped 11
→ 恢复 1750 → 1500 → 1250 → 1000 ms
```

乘法退避 + 加法恢复按设计跑完了一整个来回，最终停在 1000 ms，`11 images dropped`。这是有意的取舍（丢最旧的帧换取上传的新鲜度），不是故障。

第一次 WAITING 在 60 s 上限失败：

```
vs_social: minutes did not arrive within 60000 ms
vs_social: finalize failed while waiting for the minutes:

```

顺带：worker 的 60 s 超时在 UI 的 80 s 之前触发，这个内外层顺序是对的。

## 7. 云端时间线依然全空

31 帧 + 18 段音频，0 上传失败，但 `0 emotion / 0 audio samples`，全程无 ALERT，记录标 `partial`。`3 unanswered` 说明 inflight 表溢出了 3 次（16 槽）。

```
vs_audio: network buffers low-water 56 of 60
```

播放期间 IOB 池接近耗尽（60 个里只剩 56 的水位记录）。播放本身不碰网络，所以这更像是下载刚结束时留下的尾迹。单次出现，先记录不下结论。

按"能改且收益大"排序：

2. **播放读盘欠供**（app/）—— 需要你在"首声延迟 22 s 换零断续"和"1 s 起播但会断"之间选一个。
3. **麦克风增益**（app/ 或 board/）—— rms 545 太低，peak 削顶。
4. **core clock 27 倍差值 / 熵校验 468 ms / realign 计数溢出**（board/，我改不了）—— 这是相机 0.45 fps 和卡 8.5 KB/s 的共同上游。
5. **云端时间线为空**（云端）。

以上全部是对这份日志的算术核对和代码比对，没有上板复现，也没有改动任何文件。

系统最终稳定在 1000 ms 采样间隔配合 ~900 ms 上传的平衡点，但这个平衡实际上是由 CPU 竞争而非网络容量决定的——退避机制误以为自己在缓解网络压力，实际上是在让出 CPU 资源。

#define VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL (SCHED_PRIORITY_DEFAULT - 5)

/* The one social thread that cannot sit below the UI: the microphone drain.
 *
 * The other three produce or send data that is worth less the older it gets, so
 * being late costs a dropped frame and nothing more.  This one is the consumer
 * of a fixed-size staging ring that vs_audio.c's own capture thread fills at
 * VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO -- ten above the UI -- and a consumer below a producer is
 * an inversion with only one outcome: the ring overflows and the samples are
 * gone.
 *
 * Measured 2026-09-07 at VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL: a 74 s session had 70.5 s of audio
 * delivered by the ADC and 1009152 bytes -- 31.5 s, 44.8% of it -- discarded by
 * the ring, because the drain only managed a 48.6% duty cycle against the three
 * other threads at its own level plus the UI above it.  Half the conversation
 * never reached the encoder, and what did reach it had the two sides of each
 * hole spliced into one chunk.
 *
 * Placed below the producer rather than above it, deliberately.  Above would
 * make this thread able to starve the thread feeding it, which trades one
 * inversion for another; equal would leave them round-robin partners with no
 * guarantee.  One step below the producer and above everything else means the
 * ring is drained whenever there is anything in it, and the driver still wins
 * when both are runnable.
 */

#define VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL_AUDIO (VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO - 1)

Now I'm tackling the playback read starvation issue—the card's 8.9 KB/s read speed can't keep up with the 32 KB/s needed for 16 kHz mono audio. The solution is to preload the entire file into PSRAM before starting playback, assuming it fits within budget, then stream from memory instead. This trades off initial latency for reliable playback—at the observed file size and read speed, that's about 22.5 seconds before audio can start.

For the social finalize case, this seems bad since the user is already waiting through the download. But comparing the current behavior (playback starts at ~1 s with 2 audible underruns, finishing at 24.3 s) against full preload (22.5 s silence then 6.2 s of clean audio, finishing at 28.7 s), the tradeoff is worse total time but no gaps. The better approach is to preload while showing progress, bounded by what guarantees gapless playback—read the whole file into memory first, then play it cleanly. The latency cost is real, but chopped audio is worse for a demo, and for the history dwell case, the 2 s dwell plus 22 s read still lands around 24 s before sound starts anyway.

Actually, I'm realizing the fundamental constraint: any gapless playback of this file takes at least 22.5 s from the start of reading, since the read rate is slower than the playback rate. The only variable is whether the silence sits at the front or gets distributed as gaps throughout.

Preloading the entire file is the simplest solution and guarantees no gaps, though it means accepting that initial delay. But there's a more elegant path: since the download already pulled the bytes into RAM and wrote them to the card, I could hand those bytes directly to playback for the social finalize case and skip the read-back entirely—that would eliminate the 22.5 s overhead completely. The tradeoff is scope: it requires a memory handoff between the cloud and TTS modules and breaks the single-file-per-path contract that keeps the history logic clean.

Given the user's request to fix all fixable issues, the read starvation is a real problem worth addressing. Preloading solves the audio quality issue at the cost of latency, which is the honest fix within the current architecture. I'll implement it with a configurable budget, log the preload time for visibility, and be explicit about the latency trade-off in my comments and report.

修好了四个在 `app/` 内可修的问题，固件构建通过，velasight 零告警。

## 1. 音频优先级倒置（45% 丢音的直接机制）

填 ring 的是 `vs_audio` 内部采集线程，`VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO` = 默认 **+10**；抽 ring 的是社交音频 worker，`VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL` = 默认 **−5**，在 UI 之下，还要和采集 worker、上传 worker 抢同一级。消费者永远输给生产者，ring 一满就丢。

新增 `VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL_AUDIO = VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO - 1`，`social_spawn()` 改成按线程收优先级参数：只有音频 worker 用新值，capture / upload / session / retry 仍在 UI 之下。

放在生产者**下面一级**而不是上面是有意的 —— 放上面会让消费者能饿死喂它的线程，等于把一个倒置换成另一个；同级则是 round-robin 没有保证。低一级、高于其余一切，意味着 ring 里有东西就一定会被抽走，而驱动在两者都可运行时仍然赢。

## 2. staging ring 4.1 s → 16.4 s

`CONFIG_VS_AUDIO_CAPTURE_RING_BYTES` 131072 → 524288。

实测的关键点：消费者处理一个 2 s 块要约 4.1 s，而旧 ring 容量正好是 4.096 s —— 它不是偶尔溢出，是**永久卡在临界点上**。四倍余量把持续性丢弃变成消费者能追回来的缓冲。

Kconfig 帮助里写清了这只是地板不是解药：能不能追上取决于优先级，指向上面那条。

## 3. 空洞不再被静默拼进同一个块

`vs_audio_capture_read()` 只返回 ring 里现有的字节，**没有任何不连续信号**（我核对了实现）。所以一个块会悄悄装进空洞两侧的语音，以"连续两秒"的名义交给云端 —— 而暂停分支专门写了注释拒绝这么做，理由一字不差，只是溢出不走那条路。

音频 worker 现在每轮读一次 `vs_audio_capture_level()`，`dropped` 一涨就像暂停那样丢弃当前 `filled` 重新起块：

```
vs_social: microphone gap 1, 65536 bytes (2048 ms) lost, chunk restarted
vs_social: 3 microphone gap(s) this session, 96000 bytes of partial chunks discarded to keep the timeline honest
```

代价是每次空洞丢掉最多 2 s 好音频，换 `audioTimeline` 的时间戳不说谎。这和暂停分支是同一个取舍。前 5 次逐条打印，之后只在收尾汇总。

## 4. 播放读盘欠供 → 先全量入内存再开 DAC

这条是算术问题，不是运气问题：卡读 **8.9 KB/s**，16 kHz 单声道要 **32 KB/s**，只够 28%。加大块只减少调用次数，不提高吞吐。

`vs_tts` 现在对 ≤ `CONFIG_VS_TTS_PRELOAD_MAX_BYTES`（默认 1 MB = 32 s 音频）的文件先整份读进 PSRAM，读完再开 DAC，然后按 64 KB 切片喂（切片是为了 stop 仍然及时）。超预算或 PSRAM 不够则回退流式，并明确说明是哪一种：

```
vs_tts: preloaded 199680 bytes in 22467 ms (8 KB/s)
vs_tts: finished after 199680 of 199680 bytes, preloaded, 4 read(s) ..., 0 underrun(s)
```

**这不会让播放更快结束，也不可能** —— 音频播不快于读。变的只是等待的位置：从句子中间的破洞挪到开头的静默。这是有意接受的取舍，我在代码注释和 Kconfig 里都写明了。对本次那个文件，行为从「1 s 起播 + 2 次断音 + 24.3 s 结束」变成「22.5 s 静默 + 6.2 s 干净音频」。

如果你觉得首声延迟不可接受，真正的出路是让下载路径把字节直接交给播放（网络已经把它们读进内存过一次），那样能整段省掉 22.5 s —— 但那要打破 vs_tts「按路径标识、同路径 no-op」的契约，是另一个量级的改动，我没有做。

## 构建

```
./build_and_flash.sh                    EXIT=0
```

| 产物 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| `nuttx.bin` | 1485632 字节，三份 AP sha256 `958e072b…f96b1a` 一致，`cmp` = 0 |
| `all-app.bin` | 5709824 字节，sha256 `e940223c…2ca754` |
| `app_ab_crc.rbl` | 5640192 字节 |

改动只在 `app/velasight/`。`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c` 的 M 标记是本次会话之前就有的未提交改动，我没碰。

## 没修的，以及为什么

**相机 0.45 fps**（1318 帧编码完成只交付 34 帧，`hw_busy=1249`，熵校验 468 ms/帧）—— 全在 `bk7258_camera_imgdata.c` / `bk7258_jpeg_enc.c`，board/ 里。这是云端只拿到 20 张图（0.27 fps，比接口文档期望的 5 fps 低 18 倍）的直接原因。

**`core clock measured=17719 kHz configured=480000 kHz`** —— 两次读数 13061 / 17719，27 倍差值同时解释熵校验 468 ms、Opus 编码约 2 s、SD-NAND 8.9 KB/s（PIO 是 CPU 搬字节）。这是上面几乎所有问题的共同上游，在时钟配置与 board/ 里。**在这一条查清之前，我这四个修复都是在应用层绕开症状。**

**麦克风电平**（rms −35.6 dBFS，峰值 99.9% 满刻度，削顶 289 样本）—— 增益档位问题，不在 app/ 的可调范围内；`vs_audio_volume_set` 只管播放侧。

**上传/采样的反馈病理** —— 环满目前被解释成"链路跟不上"，实际是"CPU 跟不上"。退避机制按设计工作，只是信号含义和假设不符。在时钟问题解决前改它收益有限。

**云端时间线为空** —— 云端侧。但音频侧现在至少有一部分是设备责任已经明确（半量 + 空洞 + 过轻），修复 1–3 应该能改善这部分。

## 上板验证要看的

```
vs_social: microphone: N samples (M ms), ..., 0 bytes dropped   ← 期望 dropped 归零或大幅下降
vs_social: N microphone gap(s) this session, ...                ← 期望不出现
vs_social: session ... totals: ... 35+ chunks                    ← 74 s 会话应接近 37 块而不是 18
vs_tts: preloaded ... / finished ..., preloaded, ..., 0 underrun(s)
```

我没有烧录也没有上板，四个修复的效果全部未实测。烧录命令：`./build_and_flash.sh --flash -p /dev/ttyUSB1 -n 1`。

**卡口一：`bk7258_camera_imgdata` 丢掉 94.8% 的已编码帧（`hw_busy=1249`）。**

编码器每秒完成 17.7 帧，只有 0.46 帧能出到 V4L2。即使上传无限快，整条链路也只有 0.46 fps —— 已经比 2 fps 配置低 4.3 倍。这是硬上限，在 board/ 里。

顺带一个值得注意的对比：集成方案 1.2 节记录这条 `/dev/video0` 直出 JPEG 路径在 480×480 下 `n>1` 会**固定失败**，只有 640×480 能连续出帧且只有 1.26 fps。现在 480×480 不再失败了（有人修过），但 0.46 fps 仍比方案记录的 1.26 fps 低 2.7 倍。而方案当初选定的是另一条路径（UYVY + `/dev/video1` M2M，实测 3.16 fps），实现最终走的是被方案否决的这条。

**卡口二：上传吞吐 ~0.6 次/秒，连饿着的相机都喂不完。**

需要上传的条目：31 图 + 18 音频 = 49 条 / 74.3 s = **0.66 条/秒**。上传实际完成 38 条 = **0.51 条/秒**。按 1640 ms/次算能力上限约 **0.61 条/秒**。差 23%，这就是社交环丢掉 11 帧的原因。

对照 2 fps 配置的需求：2 图/秒 + 0.5 音频/秒 = **2.5 条/秒**。上传能力 0.6 条/秒，**差 4.2 倍**。所以即使相机修好，上传也接不住。

## 两个卡口的共同上游

上传慢和相机丢帧不是两件独立的事：

- 前 10 次上传 3099 ms/次，当时图像间隔 500 ms；退避到 2000 ms 后立刻降到 857 ms/次。**采样快 4 倍，上传慢 3.6 倍。**
- 采集 worker 每帧要等 468 ms 的熵校验，和上传 worker 同在优先级 95。
- CPU 占用估算：熵校验 34×468 ms = 15.9 s，Opus 编码 18×~2.1 s ≈ 37.8 s，合计 **53.7 s / 74.3 s = 72%** 单核时间。

再加上 SD-NAND 8.9 KB/s（PIO 就是 CPU 搬字节）、64 KB JSON 解析慢，四件事指向同一个数字：

```
core clock measured=17719 kHz  configured=480000 kHz     （上一轮 13061）
```

**27 倍差值。**如果核心真的没跑在 480 MHz，那么熵校验 468 ms（480 MHz 下应约 17 ms）、Opus 2 s（应约 80 ms）、卡 8.9 KB/s 全都是同一个根因的不同表现 —— 而我在 app/ 里做的那些修复（写聚合、预载、优先级、ring 扩容）都只是绕开症状。

这个测量本身也可能是被抢占导致的低估，需要独立验证（读时钟配置寄存器，或跑一段纯 CPU 基准）。但它是目前唯一能一次解释四个现象的假设，也是最该优先查的一条。

## 还有一层协议开销

即使 CPU 和相机都修好，5 fps 也不便宜：协议要求**每个文件一次注册 POST** 换预签名 URL，然后一次 PUT。5 fps 意味着每秒 5 次注册往返 + 5 次直传 = **10 次 HTTPS 事务/秒**，外加 110 KB/s 载荷。3 fps 是 6 次/秒。这个结构性成本和相机无关，在评估 5 fps 可行性时要一起算。

## 结论

- 目标：本轮 3 fps（69 KB/s），出厂配置 2 fps（47 KB/s）
- 实测：0.27 fps 到云端（9.7 KB/s 在途），距出厂配置差 4.8 倍
- 第一卡口：相机驱动丢 94.8% 已编码帧，在 board/
- 第二卡口：上传 0.6 条/秒，差 4.2 倍
- 共同上游：单核 72% 被熵校验和 Opus 吃掉，疑似核心时钟低 27 倍
- 网络**不是**瓶颈：链路在低负载时能到 16 KB/s，而系统整体只用掉 7.4 KB/s

text:
是我上一轮的优先级改动直接造成的死机。日志的算术把机制锁得很死。

## 卡死机制

我把音频 worker 设成了 `VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO - 1` = 默认 **+9 = 109**，在 UI（100）和输入（101）之上。

那个推理只对「干完活会阻塞」的消费者成立。这个消费者不会：编码一个 2 s 块要 ~3.2 s CPU，而 ADC 以实时速度往 ring 里灌，所以 ring **永远不空** → `vs_audio_capture_read()` 永远不返回 `-EAGAIN` → 循环里唯一的 `usleep` 永远走不到 → 一个不睡觉的线程跑在 UI 之上。

日志三处数字互相印证：

**一、45.7 秒完全静默。** 15:08:35.710 之后到 15:09:21.406 之间没有任何 `set_buf`（采集 worker 95 被饿死）、没有任何 TLS（上传 worker 95 被饿死）、没有重绘、没有按键。凡是低于 109 的全停了。

**二、第一次丢音出现在 43 秒后，正好是 ring 填满的时间。** ADC 进 32000 B/s，worker 出 64000 B / 3.2 s = 20000 B/s，净增 12000 B/s。我上一轮把 ring 从 128 KB 加到 512 KB：524288 ÷ 12000 = **43.7 s**。会话 15:08:33 起，算出 15:09:16.7，实测首次 gap 15:09:21.4。

**三、`AUDIO DROPPED` 的 3.2 秒周期就是编码周期。** 15:09:30.822 / 33.913 / 37.113 / 40.208 / 43.373 / 46.674 / 49.996，间隔 3.1–3.3 s。上传自 15:08:35.7 起停摆，16 槽社交环从那时开始积压：15:08:35.7 + 16×3.2 = 15:09:26.9，实测首次 15:09:30.8。

所以我把「丢 45% 音频」换成了「整机失去响应」。**加优先级不能修一个平均速度不够的消费者，只会把它的欠账转嫁给屏幕。**

## 修复

**1. 优先级降到 UI 之下。** `VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL_AUDIO` 从 `VS_PRIORITY_AUDIO - 1`（109）改成 `VS_PRIORITY_SOCIAL + 2`（**97**）—— 比另外三个社交 worker（95）高两级，这是当初真正想要的优势；比 UI（100）和输入（101）低三级，这条是硬约束。跟不上的消费者现在会明显落后，而不是把屏幕一起拖走。

**2. 循环里加一个与优先级无关的调度点。** 编码完一块后无条件 `sched_yield()`。走这条路径时 ring 里往往还有数据，于是它会直接回头再编一块，一次都不睡。现在它睡不睡不再取决于运气，也不再取决于谁哪天又去调优先级。

**3. Opus 复杂度：9 → 0。** 这是唯一真正降低欠账的改动。`opus_encoder_init()` 从来没设过 `OPUS_SET_COMPLEXITY`，所以一直跑在 libopus 默认的 **9**（0–10 里第二贵）。那个默认假设宿主机编码远快于实时，这块板子不是。0 通常比 9 快数倍，代价是率失真效率 —— 而这里是 16 kHz 单声道语音、24 kbps、送给识别器，是最不在乎那个的场景，何况备选项是丢掉一半。

加了 `CONFIG_AUDIO_TEST_OGG_COMPLEXITY`（默认 0）在 `app/audio_test/Kconfig`。这个编码器是 velasight 和 audio_test 共用的，两边一起受益。

**4. 编码器状态搬回 SRAM。** 原来硬传 `prefer_psram=true`，理由是 38 KiB 状态和 pthread 栈抢 SRAM。那个理由对它当年的调用顺序成立，对现在不成立 —— 编码器是在音频 worker **内部**创建的，四个栈（含本线程自己的 32 KiB）此时都已就位，之后不再创建线程。而启动日志写着 `PSRAM online ... RW/XN/non-cacheable`：编码器高频访问的工作集一直在不带缓存的外部内存里，这很可能是 3.2 s 的一大块。改成 `false` 是零风险的 —— `audio_test_ogg_encoder_create()` 本身就在 SRAM 失败时回落到 PSRAM，最坏情况等于原样。

**5. ring 从 512 KB 收回 256 KB。** 我上一轮加到 512 KB 是错的方向。ring 是给「暂时落后」的消费者留的余量，对「平均落后」的消费者只能买来更长的积压 —— 而这里积压的是要和视频时间线对齐的音频，深度会把「丢了一些音频」变成「所有音频都比对应的帧晚到越来越多」，那更糟，因为它是错的而不是缺的。512 KB 就是 16 秒漂移的样子。8.2 s 够吃下一次卡顿，又不让延迟本身变成问题。

input.text:
feat(velasight): finish the social session end to end and fix its I/O cost

The session could reach a summary but never a voice, and the storage and
scheduling costs behind it were large enough to lose most of what it
captured.  This is that whole path.

Playing the minutes
  New vs_tts: one worker owning "speak this WAV file", so the session can
  hand over a path and get on with teardown while the history page can
  start and stop playback from the UI thread, which vs_audio forbids from
  doing anything but stop() on a handle.  Replaying the file already
  playing is a no-op, which is what lets a session's own result page and
  the history entry it just wrote compose without restarting the audio.

  Minutes are filed per record as R*.WAV beside the record body, so a
  session can be played back later; vs_history names them and removes
  them on eviction, because nothing outside it is told a record was
  evicted.  The presigned URL lives an hour, so the fetch has to happen
  during finalize or not at all.

Staged finalize, and a retry that resumes
  The finalizing page was one static frame over stopping capture, closing
  the session, waiting for minutes, writing the card and fetching audio --
  measured together at over seventy seconds, which a user cannot tell from
  a hang.  It now reports five stages, each refreshing a deadline sized
  for that stage rather than for their sum.

  The audio is fetched before the result is posted, so the page holds until
  there is nothing left to wait for and the page change and the first sound
  happen together.

  A finalize that fails after the close was accepted keeps its msgId and
  offers to run the tail again: the result is still stored server side and
  re-reading it is a repeat, not a recovery.  Measured on board, a first
  attempt timed out at 60 s and the retry answered in 9 s.

Storage I/O
  Downloads wrote once per TLS record.  mbedtls_ssl_read() returns at most
  one record however large a buffer it gets -- about 1.4 KB here -- and
  this is FAT on SD-NAND with a 1-bit bus, single-block PIO and no write
  buffer, so every write straddled 512-byte sectors at both ends and FAT
  read them back to modify them.  Measured: 114054 bytes in 62.6 s,
  1.8 KB/s, slow enough that the peer reset the connection.  Aggregating
  into sector-aligned 32 KB blocks took the same transfer to 8.4 KB/s in
  7 writes, which is the card's ceiling.

  Playback had the mirror problem.  The card reads at 8.9 KB/s against the
  32 KB/s that 16 kHz mono consumes, so a streamed file underruns by
  arithmetic.  Files within budget are now read whole before the DAC opens.
  That does not finish sooner -- audio cannot play faster than it reads --
  it moves the waiting to the front, where it is a pause instead of holes
  inside the sentence.

Audio capture
  The drain sat below the UI while vs_audio's filler sat ten above it, and
  the ring held four seconds.  Measured: 70.5 s delivered, 31.5 s (44.8%)
  discarded, because the drain needed 4.1 s per 2 s chunk -- exactly the
  ring's capacity, so it lived on the edge of overflowing.

  Raising the drain above the UI was tried and is a hang: the encode costs
  more than the audio it consumes, so the ring never empties, the -EAGAIN
  that makes it sleep never comes, and 46 s passed with no frame, no upload
  and no key serviced.  It now runs two above the other social workers and
  three below the UI, with an unconditional yield per chunk so no future
  priority change can reintroduce that.

  The actual deficit is the encoder.  Nothing ever set OPUS_SET_COMPLEXITY,
  so it ran at libopus's default of 9; it is now a Kconfig defaulting to 0,
  which trades rate-distortion efficiency this application does not need.
  The 38 KiB encoder state also moves back to SRAM -- PSRAM here is mapped
  non-cacheable, and the reason it was forced to PSRAM does not apply where
  the encoder is actually created.

  Ring depth is 8.2 s, not more: a ring is slack for a consumer that is
  momentarily behind, and for one behind on average extra depth only buys a
  longer backlog -- which for audio the cloud aligns against video turns
  incomplete into wrong.

  A gap is no longer spliced silently.  vs_audio_capture_read() cannot
  report a hole, so a chunk used to carry both sides of one as contiguous
  seconds; the drain now watches the drop counter and restarts the chunk,
  which is what the pause path already did for the same reason.

Also here
  Release the camera and microphone when capture stops rather than after
  the minutes, the download and the playback -- measured 100.8 s of the
  sensor, JPEG encoder and DMA running at 2 fps with no consumer, a console
  line per frame, and CPU taken from the transfer that was the only thing
  still working.

  History records play their minutes after two seconds of dwell and stop on
  navigation, decided from page and index in the main loop rather than from
  the five key handlers that move the selection.

  Wi-Fi reconnect interval 20 s to 10 s.

Carried across unchanged: previously uncommitted work on the idle
assistant's transcript rendering (vs_voice.c and its Kconfig), which shares
files with the above and could not be separated from it.

Verified by build only: ai_agent builds clean with no warnings from these
sources, and all-app.bin packages the AP byte for byte.  Not flashed, so
the audio and playback measurements above are the motivation for these
changes rather than results of them.

## 为什么分成两个

`board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c` 是**本次会话之前就在工作区里的未提交改动**，我没有写它。内容是 ifdown 时等待 role stop 确认、确认不到就强制置 idle。它和 app/ 完全无关，能干净分离，所以单独一个提交。

其余 17 个文件合成一个。这里必须说清楚：`app/velasight/vs_voice.c` 和 `app/velasight/Kconfig` 里的 `VS_VOICE_TRANSCRIPT_MAX_BYTES` 那部分（闲时助手的字幕渲染，368 行）**也是会话前就有的未提交工作**，不是我写的。它和我的改动共用同一批文件（Kconfig、vs_app.c、vs_social.c 都是混合的），拆开需要交互式分块暂存，我不能用。所以我把它一起提交了，并在 commit message 末尾明确写了这一点。

## 提交里包含的内容

按关注点分组写在 message 里：播放纪要（新 vs_tts 模块、每条记录一个 WAV）、阶段化 finalize 与可恢复的重试、存储 I/O（下载写聚合、播放预载）、音频采集（优先级、复杂度、ring 深度、空洞检测）、以及相机及时释放、历史页停留播放、Wi-Fi 重连 10 s。

每组都带了促成它的实测数字（1.8→8.4 KB/s、44.8% 丢音、46 s 无响应、100.8 s 相机空转等），并且写明了那次「把优先级抬到 UI 之上导致死机」的尝试及其结论 —— 因为那是下一个人最容易重犯的错。

## message 里明确标注的限制

> Verified by build only: ai_agent builds clean with no warnings from these sources, and all-app.bin packages the AP byte for byte. Not flashed, so the audio and playback measurements above are the motivation for these changes rather than results of them.

- `vs_tts` same-path `vs_tts_play()` is a **no-op contract** (not optimisation) so session result page → history entry composes without restart.
- New `vs_tts` module rather than duplicating the chunk loop: UI thread may only call `stop()` per `vs_audio.h` threading contract.
- Camera/mic released in `social_stop_producers()` (was after playback) + `frames_malformed` snapshot so `social_log_totals()` no longer needs the camera handle.
- 5 finalize stages (`enum vs_social_stage_e`) + `VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STAGE`; per-stage watchdog (STAGE event clears `social_stage_until_ms`). Rejected single total deadline: sized for the sum, useless as hang detector, and fired on a merely-slow cloud.
- `vs_social_retry_finalize()`/`vs_social_can_retry()` reuse `session_thread`/`session_joinable`/`running`. `vs_social_can_retry()` deliberately does **not** check `running` (else key never offered); `-EBUSY` shown as transient "稍等" hint.
- `enum vs_retry_kind_e {VS_RETRY_NONE, VS_RETRY_NETWORK, VS_RETRY_SOCIAL}`; `vs_set_error()` defaults to NETWORK, social paths override after.
- `VS_WIFI_RETRY_MS` 20000 → 10000 (`vs_app.c:113`).
- Reverted 24 kHz→16 kHz 3:2 resampler at user request (cloud switched to 16 kHz; confirmed `16000 Hz` in latest log).
- Corrections made to earlier claims: camera idling was NOT the download bottleneck; uploads are ~16 KB/s not 24-28 KB/s (nearly half were 6 KB audio); reads are NOT faster than writes; **validator 468 ms was mostly contention, not intrinsic work** (now 61 ms with no driver change); `core clock measured` varies 11461/13061/17719 kHz with no correlation to throughput → likely a preemption-distorted measurement, not a real 27x clock deficit.
